Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and clear asks. Attached is our proposed MAP and the first-pass benchmark plan (redwood_map_benchmark_plan_v1.pdf). High level: 

1) Week 0 (Aug 17–21): onboarding + dataset slice and benchmark script exchange.
2) Week 1 (Aug 24–28): dry-run and baseline runs (single-concurrency, quantization variants).
3) Week 2 (Aug 31–Sep 4): full sweep across concurrencies (1/8/32), streaming enabled, and KV cache/ batching profiles.
4) Week 3 (Sep 7–11): regression checks, artifact packaging (CSV + short readout), and validation call.

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- TTFT p50 <= 80ms; p95 <= 220ms; p99 <= 420ms for target model variant at concurrency 1.
- Streaming token latency p50/p95/p99 must not degrade >40% vs single-token baseline at concurrency 8.
- Sustained throughput within 10% of advertised tokens/sec at target config.

Marcus / Laura — quick results from the baseline sweep (attached CSV 'mediserve_bench_summary_08018.csv') run against the 7B quantized variant with streaming enabled. I ran the scripted workload Alyssa shared (short dialog turns, ~24 tokens output avg). Key numbers below (all wall-clock):

Concurrency 1 (single client):
- TTFT p50: 62ms
- TTFT p95: 138ms
- TTFT p99: 290ms
- Streaming token latency p50: 18ms, p95: 44ms, p99: 110ms
- Throughput (tokens/sec, sustained): 820 t/s

Concurrency 8 (synthetic parallel clients, uniform arrival):
- TTFT p50: 78ms
- TTFT p95: 210ms
- TTFT p99: 510ms
- Streaming token latency p50: 30ms, p95: 110ms, p99: 240ms
- Throughput (tokens/sec, aggregate): 6,200 t/s (approximately linear until KV cache contention observed)

Notes / observations:
- p99 TTFT at concurrency 8 is above the initial acceptance threshold (510ms vs target 420ms). Root cause in this sweep looks like occasional KV cache miss storms during concurrent cache growth; we can mitigate with pre-warm policy or a smaller per-request context window.
- Streaming token latency remains within a 2.2x factor at p95 vs single-client baseline for most tokens; p99 shows tail amplification on a small subset of requests.
- Batching configuration used: dynamic batching up to 16 tokens, batch timeout 8ms; we can dial down batch timeout to improve TTFT at minor throughput cost.

Next steps proposed in-MAP:
- Action item: Redwood to run a controlled KV pre-warm + tighter batching config and re-run p99-focused measurement (target completion Aug 20). Owner: Vanessa.
- Action item: MediServe to provide a representative 1k-dialog sample and peak concurrency profile by Aug 19. Owner: Alyssa.
- Validation call proposed: Sep 9, 11:00 PT (post full sweep and artifact packaging).

I attached a quick PNG showing p50/p95/p99 curves (streaming_ttft_p99_graf.png) and the CSV. Marcus: if you agree, I'll run the mitigations tomorrow and update artifacts.
